# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

I received an air purifier, but it doesn’t work well, so I’d like to return it and get the refund back to my original method of payment.

My name is daiki_johnson_9523, and I’m in Denver, USA, 80273. I don’t remember the email address on the account, unfortunately.

Also, before we finish, could you let me know whether I’d be able to return a vacuum cleaner too? I’m not sure yet, so I don’t want to process anything for that one right now.

Thank you for your help.

I can help with that, but first I need to authenticate your account.

I can only verify by:
- email, or
- first name + last name + zip code

I can’t use the user ID alone for authentication. Also, the location needs the ZIP code only, not city/country.

Please provide:
- your first name
- your last name
- your ZIP code

Then I can look up your account, check the delivered air purifier order for return eligibility, and also tell you whether a vacuum cleaner order would be eligible to return without processing it.

Of course — my first name is Daiki, last name is Johnson, and my ZIP code is 80273.

Thanks.
